reference_audit_verification.scope: Attainable-rubric reference audit, recomputed from saved records; not a comprehension score.

freeze.scope: Synthetic fresh task responses + loopback privacy, not real-world risk estimates.

holdout_eligibility.note: Statistical eligibility only; this report adopts and enables nothing.

execution.note: Budgets are checked before each batch. Calls already in flight (at most the worker count) can exceed call/token/time budgets; the adapter has a fixed per-call timeout and the provider offers no hard token cap. Reported usage is actual CLI-reported usage only.

artifact_scope: Capture reports retain synthetic alias-to-original source maps for owner-side grading. They are synthetic evaluation artifacts for owner review, not production privacy data or shareable results.

adoption.holdout_use_status: Not the first recorded candidate use of this holdout.
adoption.reason: Holdout only; inspect privacy, repeat distributions and hard failures. Nothing is automatically enabled.
